title: Sprint 6 — Real-World Patterns & Capstone
description: Apply everything learned. Build a real data model, optimize it, and solve production-grade queries.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Change Streams & Real-Time Data
tickets.description:
Watch for collection changes.
Use filtered change streams.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.1 — Watch for Collection Changes
tasks.description: Listen for real-time changes to data in a collection using change streams.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.2 — Filtered Change Streams
tasks.description: Process only specific types of changes in real-time by applying filters to change streams.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Advanced Patterns
tickets.description:
Apply the computed pattern.
Apply the outlier pattern.
Apply the polymorphic pattern.

tasks.title: Task 6.2.1 — The Computed Pattern
tasks.description: Optimize read performance by pre-computing and storing values that are frequently read but rarely updated.

tasks.title: Task 6.2.2 — The Outlier Pattern
tasks.description: Handle edge cases in your data model, such as documents that exceed the maximum size limit.

tasks.title: Task 6.2.3 — The Polymorphic Pattern
tasks.description: Design collections to store documents with similar but slightly varying schemas.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Capstone Project
tickets.description:
Design and build a complete data model.
Build an analytics dashboard pipeline.
Harden the system for production.

tasks.title: Task 6.3.1 — Design & Build a Complete Data Model
tasks.description: Apply advanced data modeling patterns to build a robust schema for a complex application.

tasks.title: Task 6.3.2 — Analytics Dashboard Pipeline
tasks.description: Construct a comprehensive aggregation pipeline to power a data-intensive analytics dashboard.

tasks.title: Task 6.3.3 — Production Hardening
tasks.description: Implement security, performance, and reliability best practices to prepare a database for production.
